artworks.title: Throne of Pelops (detail: Poseidon and Alcyone)
artworks.description: Pausanias describes the throne of Pelops at Amyclae carved with Poseidon and Zeus carrying off the Pleiads Taygete and Alcyone, daughters of Atlas — one of the few ancient monuments to name the Pleiad beside her sister in the abduction that bound Sparta's mountain to the stars.
